unmapped_concepts.Accelerationist Interpretation: Accelerationists would view this as a 'great equalizer' that allows for rapid, meritocratic advancement in the field of agentic AI.
unmapped_concepts.Safetyist Interpretation: Safetyists would view this as a period of extreme risk, as the lack of experienced practitioners means we are deploying powerful, autonomous systems without a deep understanding of their long-term behaviors.
